lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters organized into roughly vertical columns; spacing between centroids remains relatively constant across the mid-flank section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that align with the centers of the circular blobs, forming a lattice-like structure across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single dominant horizontal linear feature on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient, with higher pixel values on the dorsal side and lower values in the shadow below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Moderate density of high-luminance spots distributed across the visible surface of the first dorsal fin, appearing as discrete, non-contiguous pixel clusters.
